retirement_age.notes: Canada has no mandatory retirement age. 65 is the age of eligibility for the Old Age Security pension. A planned increase to 67 was cancelled in 2016, so eligibility remains 65.

offices.office: Representative of the head of state
offices.title: Governor General

open_questions: King Charles III: birth date and exact start date as King of Canada were not found in a source during this run; left null.

The Governor General (Louise Arbour, installed 2026-06-08, replacing Mary Simon) is the King's representative, not the head of state; included as a separate entry for completeness. Governor General serves at the King's pleasure, so term_ends is null.
Prime Minister has no fixed term; term_ends is null. The election date 2029-10-15 is the fixed-date maximum under the Canada Elections Act; an earlier election can be called.
Canada's retirement age has no statutory mandatory value; 65 reflects Old Age Security eligibility.
